[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Remove old_lib from Obsidian Sync and restore the vault under quota[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]The `old_lib/` directory no longer syncs through Obsidian Sync from[/#D7D7AF]

[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]byte still exists on disk and in a durable backup, and [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]`ob-sync-bob.service` completes sync cycles without `Vault limit [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]exceeded`.[/#D7D7AF]

[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/bobs-org/bob-cli--beads/blob/main/pages/bob-cli-1e/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Close the backup gap and gate the destructive window[/bold #D7AFFF]          [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]backup[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]backup: capture a baseline of remote sync state, prove every old_lib [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]byte exists outside Obsidian Sync, fix the vault .gitignore case gap [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]that leaves one tax-return PDF untracked, and confirm the user decisions[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]this epic depends on.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Evacuate old_lib and push the deletions to the remote vault[/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]evacuate[dim] · [dim][/dim]after backup[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]evacuate: quiesce the sync service and nightly cron, rename old_lib to a[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]dot-prefixed staging directory so the sync client sees it as absent, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]canary-test that the server accepts deletes while over quota, then drain[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]all 660 old_lib entries from the remote.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Set the device-local exclusion and restore old_lib in place[/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]exclude[dim] · [dim][/dim]after evacuate[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]exclude: write ignoreFolders via ob sync-config, restore the staging [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]directory to old_lib while sync is still stopped, then resume the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]service and cron and confirm across several cycles that no old_lib path [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]is re-uploaded.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Verify quota recovery and run the fallback if version history [bold black on #FFD75F][/bold #D7AFFF] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
      [bold #D7AFFF]holds[/bold #D7AFFF]
    [#AF87FF]verify[dim] · [dim][/dim]after exclude[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]verify: confirm sync cycles go green, and if attachment version history [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]keeps the vault over 1 GB, execute the documented fresh-remote-vault [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]rebuild with exclusions configured before the first sync.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Document the exclusion and file the discovered follow-ups[/bold #D7AFFF]     [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]document[dim] · [dim][/dim]after exclude[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]document: record old_lib and its sync exclusion in the bob-cli README [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]vault layout, add a runbook for the procedure, and file task beads for [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the unbounded sync log and the sase memory note that omits the sync [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]topology.[/#D7D7AF]
